commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd appworker >/dev/null; then
  adduser -D -s /bin/ash appworker
fi
umask 022
mkdir -p /etc/security/limits.d /etc/profile.d
limits_tmp=/etc/security/limits.d/.appworker.conf.tmp
printf '%s\n' \
  'appworker soft nofile 8192' \
  'appworker hard nofile 8192' \
  'appworker soft nproc 256' \
  'appworker hard nproc 256' > "$limits_tmp"
chown root:root "$limits_tmp"
chmod 0644 "$limits_tmp"
mv "$limits_tmp" /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
profile_tmp=/etc/profile.d/.appworker-limits.sh.tmp
printf '%s\n' \
  '# Apply appworker limits on Alpine login shells; BusyBox login/sshd are not PAM-linked.' \
  'if [ "$(id -un 2>/dev/null)" = appworker ]; then' \
  '    ulimit -Hn 8192' \
  '    ulimit -Sn 8192' \
  '    ulimit -Hu 256' \
  '    ulimit -Su 256' \
  'fi' > "$profile_tmp"
chown root:root "$profile_tmp"
chmod 0644 "$profile_tmp"
mv "$profile_tmp" /etc/profile.d/appworker-limits.sh
printf 'created account and persistent limit policy\n'

while [ "$p" -gt 0 ]; do
  comm=$(cat "/proc/$p/comm" 2>/dev/null || printf '?')
  ppid=$(awk '/^PPid:/{print $2}' "/proc/$p/status" 2>/dev/null || printf '0')
  nofile=$(awk '/Max open files/{print $4 ":" $5}' "/proc/$p/limits" 2>/dev/null || printf '?')
  printf 'pid=%s ppid=%s comm=%s nofile=%s\n' "$p" "$ppid" "$comm" "$nofile"
  [ "$p" -eq 1 ] && break
  p=$ppid
done
